notes.title: Supplice Episode 4 is now available
notes.content:
[h1]Incoming Transmission: Episode 4 - Daphnis Awaits[/h1]

[b]Better put on your lava suit first as this is our hottest deployment to date![/b] [b]Episode 4 is live[/b] - packed with new gear, uniquely designed enemies, and five brutal maps that crank the heat way past safe levels.

[previewyoutube=NkTOkMTnR3A;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]Once a quiet moon orbiting Saturn, Daphnis has been overrun and converted into a sprawling industrial weapon by a rogue scientist and left in the hands of a barely-operational AI - one bad command away from total meltdown.Now it stands as a war-torn ruin, buried under colossal structures built for a single purpose: total destruction. As you push deeper into the wreckage, you’ll catch glimpses of the solar system’s violent past, uncovering the ruthless events and societal breakdowns that cleared the path for PTC’s rise.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048420/05496f701236bf5e880693e4cfd283a65c8284de.png[/img]

Beyond these new five maps designed with vertical sprawl and packed to the boiling point with environmental hazards, secrets, you can expect heavy resistance - luckily you have new tools at your disposal.

[list]
[*] [b]The Fission Dynamo[/b] - a high-voltage answer to overcrowded rooms. Use with extreme caution.
[*] [b]Two combat drones[/b] - autonomous allies from humanity’s forgotten wars, redeployed to watch your back. 
[*] [b]The Lava Suit[/b] - lets you swim where others melt. You’ll need it. The heat here isn’t just metaphorical.
[*] [b]High-grade armor[/b] - rugged, reliable, and built for taking sustained enemy fire.
[/list]
[h2]Full changelog:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Episode 4 “An Anthem of Hammers” added: E4M1-E4M5
[*] Level selection hub updated to feature new levels

[*] New boss enemy for Episode 4

[*] New powerups introduced: Overkill, Overload
[*] New Gameplay Options that allow inventory/upgrades to carry over between episodes, or reset on every level

notes.title: New Secret Map + News On Upcoming Updates
notes.content:
[h1]Incoming Transmission[/h1]

The team has been pretty busy over these months, but we are back with news, updates and hints of what is right behind the corner. We are gearing towards a few bigger updates around June, but to keep your content hunger satisfied - we are releasing a new secret level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048420/04fb85f11e7395756d9196a02d6478e1129c27ce.jpg[/img]
[h2]New Secret Map[/h2]

To keep you warm for the upcoming episode, we are adding a new secret level, Keep your optic nerves sharp as we have filled it with a new attraction, an attraction that bites! The astute among you might also find the secret inside the secret map - Secretception

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048420/fd6af09851ea62fcaaf8f092655fd8976867b072.png[/img]
[h2]Episode 4 [/h2]

The team has finished cooking and now is in the process of adding some finishing touches to the long awaited Episode 4. [b]You can expect to see it on your download tab in Early June.[/b] Furthermore, you can keep an eye out on our social for sneak peaks of the new episode.

[h2]New Demo[/h2]

Similar to the timeline of the new episode, we will be releasing an updated version of the demo for all those who would like to give the game a try before buying.[b] The new demo will contain a mixture of old maps along with brand new ones from Episode 2 & 3 [/b]- so you will be able not only to visit the green and lush planetside, but also go on a spacewalk and skulk around the not so desolate space station.  

[h2]Full changelog[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added support for Steam Cloud Saves
[*] Updated GZDoom engine from 4.10.0b to 4.14.1
[*] New enemy: “Yeti” (E3M6 exclusive)
[*] Pilebunker ammo has been added to the ammo tally in hud
[*] Added the Switch to last weapon” hotkey (default Q)
[*] Number added to the armor display for more precise information
[*] Added helmet overlay for oxygen-deprived areas
[*] Added option to adjust automap marker scale
[*] Added HUD counter of currently loaded Slugger shells
[*] Added burning death animations to Hiveteeth, Hivepod, Lummox and Ophaneon
[*] HUD Damage indicator now takes portals into account
[*] You can enjoy now a smoother player automap arrow indicator
[*] Fixed Arc Divider VM Abort crashes
[*] Eliminated possible softlocks in E3M3, E1M5
[*] Fixed cases of snow particles spawning through 3d floors 
[*] Fixed bugged Pilebunker glowing frame
[*] Fixed a bug with holding ESC that on startup caused controls to be temporarily locked
[*] Enlarged key sprites slightly for better visibility
[*] Overflow, Overcharge, Overflow, Overlord, Overload and Overkill power ups are now larger and spawn sparks to better display them as major power-ups
[*] Overload is now an infinite ammo powerup
[*] Added more descriptive item pickup text messages
[*] General damage output improvements on weapons (RNG randomization reduction, making especially Cyclomortar give out much more consistent damage output)
[*] Vespur damage nerfed
[*] Terpsipede scaled down a little for improved mobility
[*] Plasmatic Charges behavior retooling (much higher use control - can’t be pushed around, can be now picked up and thrown. Fire at it while in your hands to prime it for detonation; if detonated by the player, they cause no self-damage.)
[/list]
[h3]
We hope you will enjoy the new level and in the meantime, feel free to ask away on our [url=https://discord.gg/XkggvdYT]Discord [/url]channel and here on Steam[/h3]

[h1]Have a great day![/h1]

notes.content:
[h1]Episodes 3 has arrived[/h1]

[previewyoutube=0S9YEviWk5c;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Grab your trusty drills and pack something warm[/b], the newest episode is here and we are about to land in Frozen Wastes. These things will try to unsubscribe from life, but they won't if you will make them into a past tense with the brand new [b]Arc Divider[/b]! 

The Update also arrives just in time for the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Hyperstrange]Summer Sale[/url], so you can enjoy the new episode while shopping! notes.title: Episode 3 Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
[h1]Get Ready for Episode 3[/h1]

[previewyoutube=aI-uq3XTvPc;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]In case you have missed the news from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Retrovibe/sale/indiefpssummershowcase]Zlim's FPS Showcase [/url], the newest episode will be dropping on the 27th of June. [b]That is right - a whole new episode, THIS MONTH!
[/b][/h3]

[h2]Going Sub-zero[/h2]

[b]This time it is going to get cold[/b], as Zorah Null will traverse Frozen Wastes. This eerie wasteland covered in ice is your new destination and while definitely pretty, this place is an ice-cold killer. New enemies and obstacles await Zorah, sometimes even literally, as [b]you will find ice walls blocking your passage. Lucky you have the perfect ice-breaker and conversation starter - the power drill![/b]
But before you get all excited for exploration, you will have to deal with the new enemies and let me tell you - they have no chill. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048420/78d197626dfe5876340a9b9c102844f5e07cf634.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Enemies[/h2]

[b]The Terpsipede[/b] will make you feel like you have accidentally booted up a game from the Bullet Hell genre as this [b]thing does not believe in a bullet-free zone nor in friendly-fire.[/b] While this robotic tripod will make your blood pumping, the other new enemy will give you chills!

[b]The Phantalect[/b] will turn any scene into a horror show as this phantasm [b]will haunt you by entering corpses of previously slain enemies and making you fight them all over again and again.. and again[/b] - just like laundry. Unlike laundry, you can exorcize this bastard with violence and speaking of violence…

[h2]New Weapon - Arc Divider[/h2]

When you really need to unsubscribe something from existence, you pull out the [b]Arc Divider[/b]. With this gun, it does not matter if the target is far away and uncomfortably close as you can adjust the spread and accuracy with primary and secondary fire. [b]You can even charge each[/b] shot to make sure the other thing won’t be showing up on the upcoming census. [b]As an added bonus, whatever this thing won’t melt, it will leave it paralyzed for some time, so that you can finish the job.[/b]


[h1]Episode 3 is right around the corner
See you on the 27.06.2024[/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048420/e90cf4dacc667bd42d95c083c93616af87de9589.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048420/837feb3f28a9199565f25131081dd9a6a06b4fa0.png[/img]

notes.title: Warm up your drills, Episode 2 is here!
notes.content:
[h2]Patience pays off, as the day we all have been waiting for is here – continue your adventures in Supplice as Episode 2 releases today![/h2]

Whether it be that you’ve recently finished maps from Episode 1, or it’s rather been some time already, prepare yourself as the next episode is prettier than ever – all polished and enhanced just waiting for you to start yet another brutal affair. [b]Five new maps, loaded with content and pixel perfect enviro, expand Zorah’s survival story and take you on a run from a new assembly of enemies[/b].

[previewyoutube=9dYCp8MzAPw;full][/previewyoutube]

As hordes of monsters are emerging from every corner, you might spot some new faces (or at least their equivalent) among them. Take, for example, [b]Phlogis [/b]– his humanoid appearance might mislead you to prepare for some fistfight. Instead, this creature will attempt to get as close to you as possible – just to blow up in your face. Our other new opponent, a ghost called [b]Vespur[/b], is actually our melee master this time, as it floats around in the air. His huge upper limbs look like sharp blades, and so they serve this purpose. Talking about floating, [b]Effluvium[/b], despite its bubbly appearance, is a dangerous foe – a living gas emitter, so better be aware once you spot its vapors nearby.

Each level ends with a good old school intermission screens, in a nostalgic Doom vibe. They get more into the plot of Supplice’s world-saving story once you’ve cleared certain stages of the game.

All that and more waiting for you right now, so don’t waste any more time and jump back into the terraforming hell.

Best of luck,
Mekworx & Hyperstrange

notes.title: POSTAL: Brain Damaged update, Blood West Chapter 2, Supplice release date, INCISION release, new games in the catalog, and more Realms Deep 2023 news from Hyperstrange
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38371631/1699b1f20e514af85e9d00ea02a216d728938311.png[/img]

[h1]Hyperstrangers![/h1]

It is [i]that[/i] time of the year again. Boomercon is upon us! Or Realms Deep 2022, if you will. We've had six announcements this year, so let's jump into it without further ado. This serves just as a summary - more detailed posts will be popping up on appropriate game pages within a day or two. Let's go!

[h2]INCISION - Early Acces launch + Special Offers![/h2]
[previewyoutube=qlgqps4wcbU;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1734680/INCISION/
Check out our nevest, explosive release! INCISION is a rare gem - a very retro-looking, unforgiving throwback shooter, that's so full of wonderfully-executed ideas, that it feels fresh and juicy. That is if you like your juice in the taste of rust, rot, and horror. The game launched on the day of Realms Deep main event - 16 September, and is already gaining a lot of praise from the players on Steam. If you like games such as DUSK, you can't afford to miss INCISION. And speaking of DUSK - DUSK owners get extra 15% off the price that's been already lowered by 15% in the release week. Similar discount applies for owners of Nightmare Reaper and Hedon, with even more bundles on the way! Get your tetanus shot, and plunge into the horror now!

[h2]POSTAL: Brain Damaged - Horde Mode announcement[/h2]
[previewyoutube=xoMT9iW_690;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1359980/POSTAL_Brain_Damaged/
POSTAL: Brain Damaged has already gotten a small balancing update. Now, on September 19 it's getting another one. Much more substantial - it should help a lot with the balance between exploration and combat, thanks to the new ammo mechanics. Wait, that's not what you just saw in the video above? That's very perceptive! November 10 will mark the release of the Horde Mode in POSTAL: Brain Damaged, so you can spend even more time with the Brain Damaged Dude! 

[h2]Blood West - Chapter 2 announcement[/h2]
[previewyoutube=ll6tFR5ebg4;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1587130/Blood_West
Your favorite eerie wild west stealth-shooter with a bit of a immersive sim aftertaste has exceeded our initial expectations as to the reception and popularity. In wake of such success the Blood West team has been expanded, and the project was granted an extended development schedule, to deliver more content than it was originally intended. The second out of 3 chapters in the story of the Revenant Gunslinger will hit Steam on Halloween, and you'll be getting a map that's 1.5 larger and tighter packed with events and NPCs then the first one.

[h2]Supplice - release date announcement[/h2]
[previewyoutube=2YS2ZCjBTnw;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1693280/Supplice/
According to some sources, Supplice is the best-looking game in the entire Hyperstrange catalog. Well, beauty takes time! We've hold off making the announcement of the release date, to make sure Mekworx team has enough time to work their magic. Now, we're happy to announce the date you've been dying to know: [b]30 march 2023[/b]!

[h2]77p Egg: Eggwife - new game announcement[/h2]
[previewyoutube=OXD0zCu0rJw;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1317020/77p_egg_Eggwife/
We fell in love with Eggwife after first seeing it in the Realms Deep 2021 showcase. Now, after we've released POSTAL: Brain Damaged it's perfectly clear, that the audience wants us to take things a step further. Or a lot of steps further. To go so far, that we'll end up in UK. Eggwife is what would happen if the Brits came up with POSTAL, but... it's so much more. An immersive sim? A dating sim? A shopping cart driver sim? You name it! Maybe just go wishlist it, and get the Demo for you to plau

[h2]GHOSTWARE: Arena of the Dead - new game announcement[/h2]
[previewyoutube=qAiV6YUVacM;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1893370/GHOSTWARE_Arena_of_the_Dead/
We strive to bring overlooked, original titles to a broader audience. Sometimes originality isn't apparent at face value. What seems like an arena shooter with retro stylings happens to become a whole sprawling world full of adventure and danger. You can find out for yourself just what makes Ghostware so unique that it found its way to our hearts. We'e not sure of the release date yet with this one, but we do highly encourage you to wishlist it and take the available demo for a spin.

And that's that. We'll be happy to hear your thoughts on our Hyperstrange Discord, steam forums, and clay tablets. Thank you for being a part of the Hyperstrange crowd, and Stay Metal!

[h2]Your's truly,[/h2]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38371631/0703e4c0718a8efe5be90b59356042bc0910a9e2.png[/img]

notes.title: POSTAL: Brain Damaged - Connoisseur Edition (OST & Art Book bundle!) + upcoming updates!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38371631/fbb0539e05676ff94aa2b21c71c2b025479b62c1.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hyperstrange friends, RWS fam![/h1]

Hyperstrange-developed [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1359980/POSTAL_Brain_Damaged/]POSTAL: Brain Damaged[/url], the action-packed DOOM Eternal-like spin-off of the POSTAL series is finally here, and  if you own any of the eligible RWS or Hyperstrange titles, or some other staple throwback-shooters like DUSK, Hedon, or Nightmare Reaper, you can get PBD with an additional discount added on top of -20% release discount [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1359980/POSTAL_Brain_Damaged/][b]via one of the special bundle deals[/b][/url].

Plus, we're happy to report it really SLAPS! With more than 1100 reviews it currently enjoys an 'Overwhelmingly Positive' rating, with more than 95% players recommending the game.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38371631/18684ae3b765836c7dde86fa69ffe2737dfcac06.gif[/img]

Yes, Hyperstrange really pulled this one off. The game is good and the release has been relatively bug-free despite the 2-week delay made explicitly to implement some bugs and stay on-brand. But it wouldn't be a POSTAL release if something haven't gone wrong. Many of you were waiting for the release of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1359980/POSTAL_Brain_Damaged/]POSTAL: Brain Damaged Official Soundtrack[/url]. The wait is finally over! The OST has arrived, and you can get it separately or bundled with the official Art Book in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/26678/POSTAL_Brain_Damaged__Connoisseur_Edition][b]POSTAL: Brain Damaged - Connoisseur Edition[/b][/url].

[previewyoutube=q7UXDk9xsaM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]UPCOMING UPDATES[/h1]

The Hyperstrange Dev team is very grateful for the amazing reception of PBD. This gives them even more motivation to improve and expand the game post-release. Here's what to expect soon:

[list]
[*] [b]Post-release fix [/b]- an update taking care of the known issues reported by the players, that slipped into the full release (ETA: One week)
[*] [b]Balancing update[/b] - some players, as well as [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ld5VPBIQeSM]some internet micro-celebrities[/url], have brought to our attention that the game offers way to much ammo if you explore the levels 'Quake-style', and far too little if you prefer to push on 'Doom Eternal-style'. The update will take care of that issue, allowing everyone to enjoy the game in their preferred playstyle. The update will also reconfigure some of the enemy positioning, spawns, and behavior. (ETA: One month)
[*] [b]New playmodes[/b] - With that taken care of, the dev team will proceed to expanding the game itself, introducing an oft-requested horde mode, as well as another playmode offering a new, and replayable PBD experience. (ETA: This summer)
[*] [b]More to be announced![/b]
[/list]

Hyperstrange and RWS are both extremely pleased with the reception of [b]POSTAL: Brain Damaged[/b]. We're as excited as you are, to see what the future will bring to this explosive and twisted spin-off.

[b]Your true friends and family,[/b]
[h2]Hyperstrange & RWS[/h2]
